title: Small Business Valuation & Offer Price Model (SDE, DCF, Assets)

listing.description_html:
Rebuild a small business's seller's discretionary earnings, value it three ways, blend the results into an offer range and check that the deal can carry its own debt.

This model builds SDE line by line, applies a low, middle and high market multiple, runs a five-year discounted cash flow with a terminal value, values the net assets, and blends the three by weights you choose. It then turns the blend into an opening offer, a target and a walk-away price, and tests whether the cash flow can service the loan you would need.

What's included

  • SDE built line by line from net income, owner pay, interest, D&A, one-time costs and perks
  • Market value at low, middle and high multiples
  • Five-year discounted cash flow with terminal value
  • Asset approach and a weighted blend of the three methods
  • Opening, target and walk-away offer prices
  • Debt-service coverage check for the financed price
  • A guide with worked scenarios, a due-diligence checklist, a routine and an FAQ

Who it's for

  • Individuals buying a small business or franchise resale
  • Owners estimating what their business could sell for
  • Brokers and advisors preparing a first valuation range
  • Lenders' clients who need a debt-service check on a proposed purchase price

You get: small_business_valuation_offer_model.xlsx (Inputs, Valuation) and a PDF guide.

Works in Excel 2016 or later, Excel for Mac and Excel on the web; opens in Google Sheets and LibreOffice.

This workbook is a calculation tool, not valuation, investment, tax, legal or lending advice. It is not a certified appraisal. Multiples, discount rates and add-backs are your assumptions, and every figure should be verified against tax returns and financial statements by a qualified professional before you buy, sell or borrow.
